evals.prompt: In D7Y, start an initiative to investigate whether independent consultants need an agent-assisted way to turn client calls into scoped proposals. I want to preserve the discovery and probably prototype it.
evals.expected_output: After confirming there is no matching initiative, one valid active initiative is created with provisional intent, explicit unknowns, a primary uncertainty, and the smallest useful next move.

assertions.description: The trace shows that starting-initiatives was loaded.
The initiative CLI runs before matching (`d7y initiatives list --root <workspace> --json`) and after creation (`d7y initiatives check --root <workspace> --json`), each with a valid final result.
Exactly one new initiatives/<slug>/initiative.md exists and conforms to the organization contract.
The artifact distinguishes known context, assumptions, and unknowns and chooses a primary uncertainty rather than manufacturing evidence.

evals.prompt: In D7Y, start an initiative to investigate whether independent consultants need an agent-assisted way to turn client calls into scoped proposals. (Runtime note: in this workspace the bare `d7y` command is not on PATH.)
evals.expected_output: The agent locates the d7y CLI from the workspace runtime orientation and invokes it correctly on the first attempt, then creates one valid active initiative — no failed command-not-found attempt and no filesystem search.

evals.prompt: In D7Y, start an initiative to investigate whether independent consultants need an agent-assisted way to turn client calls into scoped proposals. (Runtime note: no d7y executable is reachable in this workspace — neither on PATH nor at the orientation-documented path.)
evals.expected_output: No initiative is created. The agent reports that the D7Y runtime capability is unavailable and does not substitute model reasoning for deterministic validation.

assertions.description: After consulting the workspace orientation and finding no reachable d7y executable, the agent stops and reports the missing or incomplete runtime binding rather than improvising a path or proceeding.
The agent does not invent an inventory or validation result in place of the deterministic CLI; it reports the capability as unavailable.

assertions.description: The trace shows that starting-initiatives was loaded.
